_doc: NoNFO-Pilot-PB2 zone contract (plan KTD6): outline, holes, zones, height limits, and the mass and power lines the S34 gates sum. Units mm and g unless named. Board frame: origin at the outline's lower-left corner, +X along the 3.400 in edge, +Y along the 2.150 in edge, +Z up from the carrier top face. [SRC] = read from the cited source; [ASSUMED] = planning value to be replaced; [CALC] = computed here. Consumers: generators (S35+), DRC rule areas (S37), Serenity-UAV tools/nonfo_simon_fit.py (copy-with-index). SPDX-License-Identifier: CERN-OHL-W-2.0.

outline.source: [SRC] KiCad 9.0.2 template BeagleBone-Black-Cape.kicad_pcb (Edge.Cuts 3.400 x 2.150 in, R 0.25 in corners). The template's RJ45 notch is not kept: no BeagleBone sits under this board.
outline.note: The SecureControllers spec quoted 86.4 x 53.3 mm from SanCloud's BBE page; the owner named the BeagleBone Black size, so the template governs.

pb2_shadow.note: PB2-I 55 x 35 mm PCB [SRC PB2 SRM Table 3.2], centred in Y, 2.0 mm from the +X edge so its USB-C can reach the outline edge (which PB2 end carries the USB-C: requires verification against avionics/datasheets/beagleboard/pocketbeagle2_revA_dimension.pdf). Rails 4.80 mm inside each long edge [SRC gen_pilot_pcb.py RAIL_V, REF-SENSOR-041 Fig 3.45].

stack.source: [SRC] PB2 SRM Table 3.2 (13.6 mm max height, 1.6 mm PCB); gen_pilot_pcb.py PB2_GAP (3.0 receptacle + 2.54 insulator) and B_MAX_H 5.04; 8.9 mm = Wurth 749010012A magnetics (tallest carrier part). [ASSUMED] carrier bottom face 0402-class passives only (1.0 mm), bridge 1.0 mm.

zones.name: iso_island
zones.note: GND2 island: ISOW1044, ISOW1412, HI-6138 + PM-DB2791S, both Ethernet magnetics; locking JST-GH field connectors on the -X edge. One seam to the logic zone, crossed only by isolator pins.

zones.name: logic
zones.note: MCU, IMU, baro, TPM, flash, hub, AX88772E, DP83825I, PLD.

zones.name: rf
zones.note: Under the PB2 shadow (all modules are under 5.04 mm): Wi-Fi LWB5+ 453-00046 (MHF4), mLRS, Type 2EL, GNSS. Coax to airframe antennas. [ASSUMED] placement; S38 sets it.

zones.name: power_entry
zones.note: Nano-Fit 5 V entry and the input filter.
